blurb: Guests attend yoga classes ranging from beginner flows to restorative and dynamic vinyasa taught by experienced local instructors. Private classes and special events are available for individuals or groups, either in the studio or off-site. The studio also offers space rental for personal and corporate events with a welcoming atmosphere and amenities.
